title: RV Command Center V9 · Aplicación privada única
description: V9: restauración auditoría Calendar-Matrix-MTS-PSICOPRO, sesiones clínicas semanales y mensuales, boxeo deduplicado, radar 15 habilidades, MTS barras, fotografías editoriales y Arica bajo demanda
deploy: Update the EXISTING RV-CCv9 Apps Script project and its existing RV-CCV9 deployment, selecting New version. Owner only, execute as Me.
configuration: Open private /exec, select Configurar conexiones to save private four Sheet URLs. Project properties are not shared between Apps Script projects.
rollback: Use Git commit history to restore previous source. No old UI or ?view=v8 route is shipped.
privateLink: Never embed Apps Script project credentials or Google Sheets IDs into public GitHub.
limitations: New private Apps Script deployment version still required
SENAPRED indexed publications not guaranteed active alerts
Wave-height forecast does not certify a maritime advisory
Clinic sheet Seguimiento Semanal counts registered sessions, not independently verified attendance
Photographic assets externally hosted, final visual spot check required
Open-Meteo licensing must be checked for commercial deployment
arica: Reloj del navegador, directorio de webcams y enlaces oficiales abiertos solo manualmente
loading: No automatic weather polling. Weather, indexed SENAPRED and dated CSN events fetched only by opening the Arica section; server-cache for 15 minutes.

modules.clinical: Weekly & month-to-date registered sessions from PSICOPRO Seguimiento Semanal
modules.boxing: Unique dates of completed Coached Boxing rows
modules.boxingRadar: 15 skill values and goals from Boxing roadmap
modules.mtsGoals: Numeric progress with direct source links
modules.arica: On-demand real sources via a single bounded batch with 15 minute server cache
